title: Approaching the Unconscious
author: Carl G. Jung
summary: Jung introduces the concept of the unconscious mind, exploring how dreams, symbols, and archetypes serve as the language through which the unconscious communicates with our waking consciousness.

title: Ancient Myths and Modern Man
author: Joseph L. Henderson
summary: Henderson examines how ancient mythological motifs — the hero, the trickster, initiation rites — continue to appear in the dreams and fantasies of modern people, revealing the timeless patterns of the collective unconscious.

title: The Process of Individuation
author: M.-L. von Franz
summary: Von Franz traces the journey of individuation — the process by which a person becomes a psychological whole — through dream analysis, showing how the shadow, anima/animus, and Self emerge as guides.

title: Symbolism in the Visual Arts
author: Aniela Jaffé
summary: Jaffé explores how archetypal symbols manifest in painting, sculpture, and architecture throughout history, from sacred stones to modern abstract art, revealing the unconscious at work in creative expression.

title: Symbols in an Individual Analysis
author: Jolande Jacobi
summary: Jacobi presents a detailed case study of a single patient's analysis, showing how symbols evolved across a series of dreams and paintings to chart the course of psychological transformation.
